title: the implementation of financial statements based on sak emkm in micro, small, and medium enterprises (case study of mutiara laundry umkm)
core_idea: This case study examines the adoption of the Financial Accounting Standards for Micro, Small, and Medium Entities (SAK EMKM) at Mutiara Laundry to assess its implications for financial transparency, managerial decision-making, and access to external funding, contextualized by challenges such as limited financial literacy and reliance on informal accounting.
tldr: A case-study exploring how adopting SAK EMKM in a service-sector MSME can be assessed for its potential impact on transparency, decision-making, and financing, addressing an empirical gap in MSME reporting practices.
